text:
```yaml
name: Main Build

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - camel-4.10.x
      - camel-4.14.x

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: main-build-${{ github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up JDK 21
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 21
          cache: maven

      - name: Cache Maven packages
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.m2/repository
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-maven-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-maven-

      - name: Build and test
        run: mvn -B -DskipTests=false -DskipITs=false -DskipITs
```
